gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.craft_r: Crafts exactly once; step-level inputs/outputs may override the recipe.

gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.insert_: Creates items without consuming materials. count=0 still creates 1; ticks=1 actually waits 12 ticks.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.fill_it: Moves items from a container into a machine slot: enter a real slot number (-1 is invalid); a partial refill still finishes.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.deposit: An empty item list means no filter; this is the step that truly unloads carried items.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.place_b: Every position in the point is used; with material consumption on, materials come from the advanced container field.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.place_f: Every position in the point is used; with material consumption on, materials come from the advanced container field.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.destroy: Every position in the point is used; drops are off by default.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.require: Every position in the point is used; count=0 actually requires at least 1.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.harvest: Uses the building work area; the radius field is unused, and ticks=1 is estimated from the tool. Attachment, support and replant options are advanced.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.breed_e: count=0 means 1 pair. The area follows the mode selected above.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.slaught: count=0 means 1 animal. The area follows the mode selected above.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.shear_e: Shearable animals only; products drop in the world. count=0 means 1.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.require: Check only, never picks up; an empty item means no item filter.
gui.simupack.industrial.behavior.collect: count is the number of dropped entities per batch (0 means unlimited), not the total item count.

gui.simupack.commercial.issue.intake_wit: Purchased item "%s" has no stock rule anywhere: this shop buys endlessly and players can sell to it forever

gui.simupack.help.title: Creation space help
gui.simupack.help.getting_started.text: Create a pack with File > New project, then add a building with Edit > New building. Select a building to capture a region from the world or import a structure file, then use File > Save.
gui.simupack.help.workspace.text: The left column contains projects, categories and buildings. The middle area contains preview, materials and category-specific editors. The right column is the inspector. View switches tabs and UI scale; the top-right buttons collapse the side columns.
gui.simupack.help.building.text: Drag the preview to rotate, use the wheel to zoom, and click to pick a position. Materials shows block counts from the captured structure; import a structure or capture the building again when it is missing.
gui.simupack.help.settings.text: Residential supports units and arrays, commercial supports trades and containers, and industry supports recipes, action groups and simulation. Confirm the category under Basics before opening its editor.
gui.simupack.help.shortcuts.text: Ctrl+S saves; Ctrl+Z undoes; Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes; ESC closes help, menus or the current dialog. In the region picker, left click sets point 1, right click sets point 2, and Enter completes.
gui.simupack.help.files.text: Drop a ZIP onto the window to import a project. Export creates an installable pack. When validation fails, read the inspector error first; for broken JSON, use Clear JSON and rebuild or inspect project files with an external editor.
